cleavage_agent: Tryptic peptides were generated following the FASP protocol of Wiśniewski et al., with minor modifications as described by Hamann et al..
labeling: inferred: Statistical evaluation was performed based on spectral counts using the edgeR package in R.
reduction_concentration: Tissues were disrupted by bead beating for 45″s at 6.0″m/s with lysing matrix D tubes (MP Biomedicals) in SDT buffer (4% [wt/vol] sodium dodecyl sulfate [SDS], 100″mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6, 0.1″M dithiothreitol [DTT]), followed by heating to 95°C for 10″min.
reduction_reagent: Tissues were disrupted by bead beating for 45″s at 6.0″m/s with lysing matrix D tubes (MP Biomedicals) in SDT buffer (4% [wt/vol] sodium dodecyl sulfate [SDS], 100″mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6, 0.1″M dithiothreitol [DTT]), followed by heating to 95°C for 10″min.
